instruction:
Open the provided init.ifc from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc using Revit's Open IFC workflow before editing, and use init_sheet.png as the local visual reference. Modify the starting model into an eight-unit duplex retrofit layout with an overall 20.0 m by 18.0 m footprint near the project origin. The wall envelope should rise about 7.0 m, include ground and upper slabs, and provide two stairs near the centre of the plan connecting the two storeys. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, two IfcBuildingStorey entities, twenty-four IfcSpace entities, eight IfcWall entities, two IfcSlab entities, and two IfcStair entities. Do not include IfcRoof, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCurtainWall, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name the spaces so the normalized IfcSpace names include eight Living Kitchen spaces, eight Bedroom spaces, and eight Bath spaces. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
